intro_text: In the spirit of transparency and accountability, we publish annual post-trip reports detailing screening metrics, financial distributions, and project evaluations.
report1_description: Recce report detailing groundwork, hospital stakeholder visits, and pharmacy assessments in Phnom Penh and surrounding areas.
report2_description: Comprehensive documentation of mass health clinics in Poipet, screening 1,068 villagers and completing 284 clinical referrals.
report3_description: Detailed evaluation of village health screenings, dental education, and scholarship distribution.
report4_description: Summary of post-pandemic trip resumption, partner institution meetings, and initial referral pathway setups.
